description: Implementation of the PlaybackService class, managing media playback sessions, shared memory buffers, and related services within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: PlaybackService
classes.description: Manages media playback sessions, shared memory buffers, and associated services within the Rialto server.

methods.name: PlaybackService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the PlaybackService with required factories and services.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Activates the playback session, creating shared memory buffer, and setting active state.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Deactivates the session, cleaning resources and resetting state.

methods.name: setMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent playbacks.

methods.name: setMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of Web Audio players.

methods.name: setClientDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name for the client, affecting environment variables.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves the shared memory file descriptor and size if available.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the session is active.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of playbacks.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of Web Audio players.

methods.name: getShmBuffer
methods.description: Returns the shared memory buffer object.

methods.name: getMediaPipelineService
methods.description: Provides access to the media pipeline service.

methods.name: getWebAudioPlayerService
methods.description: Provides access to the Web Audio player service.
